why: The Wuerzburg Cervical Cerclage Simulator is a named, reusable physical training product rather than a general instructional element; its instructional function is simulation-based practice.
name: Wuerzburg Cervical Cerclage Simulator (WCCS)
product_description: A DIY physical obstetric-procedure simulator developed by Buechel and colleagues for training novice and trainee obstetricians in performing McDonald cervical cerclage.
